review_method: Manual operation-body and upstream API-contract review before scanning; source implementation modules can include auxiliary routines, not necessarily a complete standalone application. No QCS imports or detector predictions used.
api_reference_scope: Not scored in this experiment; implementation presence is the primary user question. API truth is null, never inferred from scanner allowlists.
